Muscular Build.description:
💪 Build: Muscular Build
Visibly developed muscles across the upper body and limbs — defined arms, broad shoulders, and a strong core. A build shaped by dedicated physical training.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Muscular Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Muscular frame — developed muscle mass visible at shoulders, arms, chest, and legs. Definition showing through clothing, body fills the frame with physical weight. Female: shoulders developed while the waist stays drawn in, firm neck, soft jaw under the definition, the chest line above a drawn waist. Male: shoulders and neck thick, jaw square, a flat developed chest on a thick torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at visible development.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
